name: UIZZE — UI references for coding agents
tagline: Search focused UI references when the product needs them
description: The authenticated UIZZE MCP gives Cline focused UI reference search and hosted design-material search across 800,000+ real web and iOS screens. Use it alongside the free MIT anti-ui-slop Skill, which runs locally without an account; the Skill and GitHub Action are separate.

install.notes: Requires UIZZE authentication. The MCP exposes find_ui_references and find_ui_materials. Install the free Skill separately with npx skills add https://uizze.com --skill anti-ui-slop.
